description: A live-coding music studio on Strudel. You build songs by chatting with a real Claude Code agent working in a git repo per song: it edits the song's Strudel parts using in-repo music skills, checks its own work with a sandboxed symbolic 'ears' MCP tool (key fit, unknown sounds, drum grid, density) before you hear anything, and every change lands in the browser REPL on the next bar. Every turn is a commit, so you can compare versions A/B, branch and rewind. Under the hood: a canonical event protocol, a SQLite event log with replay, a session-adapter layer with a stream-json Claude adapter and a Claude-only terminal, in Catppuccin Mocha and Latte.
features: Chat with a real Claude Code producer per song (stream-json adapter, no Bash, only the ears MCP server executes)
ears MCP tool: strudel_check report with errors mapped to part:line, key fit, unknown sounds, per-section drum grids, density, silent and unused parts
Sandboxed check: agent code evaluated under node --permission plus an in-process network lockdown
Every agent turn is a git commit; Timeline with A/B compare, branch from here, rewind as a new commit
Strudel REPL with next-bar apply, pending pill, per-part Try/Keep edits committed as your own edits, punchcard visuals
Durable event log with afterSeq replay over WebSocket; reload restores the transcript; gateway restart marks sessions interrupted
Claude Code terminal tab (claude only, no shell) with xterm themed from tokens
Guided path (10 lessons), techno subgenre explorer (10 genres), Hydra visuals, WAV recording
Catppuccin Mocha and Latte, accent and flavor picker
demo_twin_evidence: pm2 app 2026-10-02-algorave-room-demo on 127.0.0.1:3600 (ALGORAVE_DEMO=1, data-demo/): a copy of two synthetic acceptance-test songs from the build night (no real user data); loopback-only bind; POST /api/songs/:slug/sessions returns 403 demo-mode (checked with curl), so the twin can never start an agent or a terminal
